title: SEO Starter Guide: The Basics
measures: Google's baseline guidance: checking indexing with site:, discovery via links and sitemaps, descriptive URLs, duplicate content, time to see impact, and topics not to focus on (meta keywords, content length, E-E-A-T as a ranking factor).
limitations: General guidance, not dental-specific; 'Last updated' date shown on page is used as published date. Google may change it without notice.

title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
measures: Self-assessment questions for people-first content, search-engine-first warning signs, E-E-A-T and YMYL explanation, Who/How/Why framing, warning against deceptive authorship.
limitations: Describes what Google's systems seek to reward in general terms; it is not a ranking formula.

title: Understand JavaScript SEO basics
measures: Crawling, rendering and indexing phases for JavaScript sites; recommendation that server-side or pre-rendering is still a great idea because not all bots run JavaScript; soft 404s in single-page apps; crawlable links.
limitations: Applies to Googlebot; other crawlers may behave differently.

title: In-depth guide to how Google Search works
measures: Three stages of Search (crawling, indexing, serving); not all pages make it through each stage; Google does not accept payment to rank pages higher.
limitations: High-level description; does not disclose ranking weights.

title: AI features and your website
measures: How AI Overviews and AI Mode use pages: no additional requirements or special optimizations; page must be indexed and eligible to show with a snippet; no new machine-readable files, AI text files or special schema needed; reporting inside the Search Console Performance report 'Web' search type; preview controls (nosnippet, max-snippet, noindex); Google-Extended pointer.
limitations: Google describes AI features may change; inclusion is not assured even when requirements are met.

title: What is a sitemap
measures: When a sitemap helps; a small site (about 500 pages or fewer) that is comprehensively linked internally might not need one.
limitations: Sitemaps are a hint; they do not force indexing.

title: How to specify a canonical URL with rel="canonical" and other methods
measures: Methods for indicating a canonical URL (redirects, rel=canonical, sitemap inclusion) and their relative strength as signals.
limitations: Canonical signals are hints Google weighs; Google may choose a different canonical.

title: Spam policies for Google web search
measures: Definitions of doorway abuse (including pages targeted at specific regions or cities that funnel users to one page), scaled content abuse (including generative AI pages without added value), keyword stuffing, hidden text, cloaking and link spam.
limitations: Policy page; enforcement detail is not published.

title: Do you need an SEO?
measures: Google's advice on hiring an SEO: interview, check references, request an audit, no one can promise a first-place ranking, be wary of unsolicited outreach.

title: Local business (LocalBusiness) structured data
measures: Required and recommended LocalBusiness properties; use the most specific LocalBusiness subtype; validate with the Rich Results Test and URL Inspection.
limitations: Markup makes a page eligible for features; it does not ensure they appear.

title: Google's common crawlers
measures: Googlebot and Google-Extended tokens; Google-Extended controls use of crawled content for training future Gemini models and does not affect inclusion in Google Search or act as a ranking signal.

title: Performance report (Search results): Overview and basic setup
measures: Definitions of clicks, impressions, CTR and average position; dimensions (queries, pages, countries, devices, search appearance, dates); results vary by time, place, device and history.
limitations: Search Console does not report calls, bookings or attended visits.

title: Guidelines for representing your business on Google
measures: Eligibility and naming rules for Business Profiles, address and service-area rules, phone and website rules, hours, category selection, chains, and individual practitioner rules (dentists named as practitioners; multiple practitioners at one location; solo practitioners in branded organizations).
limitations: Policy page; Google may change it without notice.

title: Tips to improve your local ranking on Google
measures: Local results are mainly based on relevance, distance and prominence (the page's summary sentence says 'popularity'; the section heading says 'Prominence'); no way to request or pay for better local ranking; prominence uses information such as links and review count and ratings.
limitations: Google keeps algorithm details confidential; factor weights are not published.

title: Tips to get more reviews
measures: Review request methods (Google link or QR code), reply guidance, protecting reviewer privacy, incentives treated as fake and misleading content.
limitations: General guidance; dental practices also have health-privacy obligations outside Google's policy.

title: Prohibited & restricted content (Maps user-generated content policy)
publisher: Maps User Generated Content Policy Help
measures: Fake engagement and rating manipulation rules: no incentives, no conflict-of-interest reviews, no discouraging negative reviews or selectively soliciting positive ones, no staff review quotas or requested content.
limitations: Policy page; Google may change it without notice.

title: Overview of OpenAI Crawlers
measures: OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search results), GPTBot (content that may be used to train foundation models), ChatGPT-User (user-initiated visits; robots.txt rules may not apply; not used to decide Search inclusion), OAI-AdsBot; settings are independent; about 24 hours for search systems to adjust after a robots.txt change; published IP ranges.
limitations: OpenAI may add or rename agents; the page shows no publication date.
